findings.title: Entrance animations all start at once
findings.evidence: 7 load animations share one start time; nothing leads the eye.
findings.fix: Give the entrance an order of importance: offset successive elements by 50–100ms (CSS `animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 70ms)` or a JS stagger) so the headline lands first and supporting elements follow.

findings.title: Interactive elements give no hover feedback
findings.evidence: 4/7 distinct controls did not change on hover: Atelier Norr, Philosophy, Request the monograph, Back to top ↑.
findings.fix: Every link/button needs a state change: buttons lift 1–2px or shift background with a 160–240ms ease-out transition and a pressed scale(.97); text links animate an underline (scaleX 0→1 from the left); cards raise shadow and scale media 1.03.

findings.title: Layout shifts while loading
findings.fix: Reserve space for images/media (width/height or aspect-ratio), load fonts with metric-matched fallbacks, and animate entrances with transform rather than inserting space.

findings.title: Text contrast is too low
findings.evidence: 7/104 checked text elements fail WCAG AA, e.g. "ii." 2.34:1, "iii." 2.34:1, "2025" 2.1:1.
findings.fix: Muted text still needs ≥4.5:1 (≥3:1 for 24px+). Raise lightness contrast of secondary text instead of lowering opacity.

findings.title: Layout properties are animated
findings.evidence: 40 animations/transitions on height, marginLeft, margin-left, marginTop, margin-top; 151 inline-style layout writes.
findings.fix: Animate transform and opacity (and clip-path for reveals) instead of width/height/top/left/margin; they run on the compositor and avoid reflow jank. For accordions use grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr or measure once and animate a scale/clip.

notes: External origins requested: https://fonts.googleapis.com, https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net, https://fonts.gstatic.com (passive font/style/script/image GETs allowed; anything else blocked)
